```{r,echo=FALSE}
n = sample(3:10,1)
S = sample(letters,n)
```

Question
========

Let set $S$ represent a collection of lower-case letters:

$$S=\{`r paste0(S,collapse=",\\,")`\}$$

Calculate the number of subsets of $S$.

Solution
========

Set $S$ has `r n` elements.

$$n(S)~=~`r n`$$

The formula for the number of subsets is $2^{n(S)}$.

$$2^{`r n`}=`r 2^n`$$


Meta-information
============
extype: num
exsolution: `r 2^n`
exname: number_subsets
